benchmark.dependencyPolicy: AT initial hit is the sole primary numeric likelihood. Bonus initial hit and CZ are DISPLAY_ONLY and are not multiplied.
benchmark.exposureAssumption: benchmark N games means N observed normal-game trials for AT initial hit. Runtime confidence remains separate.

simulation.method: Repository generic seeded Monte Carlo calculator
simulation.featureConstruction: FEAT_AT_INITIAL binomial reconstructed from fresh Research + Selection

notes: Settings outside low/high groups are excluded from this benchmark by Manifest definition.
Evidence constraints are not included in HighLowDiscrimination.
This benchmark is setting-group discrimination reference information, not runtime 判定信頼度.
Bonus initial hit and CZ are intentionally excluded to preserve the dependency boundary with AT initial hit.
Values are generated with the repository generic calculator algorithm, seed 20260920 and 20000 samples/group.
